item.title: By: stupidGirlFriend
item.dc:creator: stupidGirlFriend
item.description: I can attest that Ed's new IPA is going to be delish. I can also attest that it's amusing when Ed putters around the house for an hour after the official tasting, periodically pausing with a nirvana-like expression to exclaim, "Dang, that was good beer!"
item.content:encoded: I can attest that Ed’s new IPA is going to be delish. I can also attest that it’s amusing when Ed putters around the house for an hour after the official tasting, periodically pausing with a nirvana-like expression to exclaim, “Dang, that was good beer!”
